description: A remote viewer's own board.undo and board.redo. Writes carry viewer and step. One step groups every write with that id. Undo reverts only fields still equal to what that step wrote: another actor's edit of a different field stays, and an edit of the same field is kept. Deleting and undoing restores the same id at a fresh revision unless its key was taken. A repeated undo or redo of a step already replayed changes nothing. A viewer's new accepted step clears that viewer's redo.
